title: Campaign brief for the spring launch
brief: Write the brief for a four-week campaign announcing offline mode to existing customers. Budget 8000 EUR, email and in-app only, no discounts. It must state the goal with one number to move, the audience, the message in one sentence, the plan week by week, how the budget is split, and what would make us stop early. One page, at most 500 words.
stands_for: work whose result is a document
